name: Orkes: Diagnose 'Prompt … is not associated with integration … and model …'
query: My workflow fails on Orkes with: "Prompt You are a helpful assistant that classifies tickets into billing, technical or sales is not associated with integration openai-prod and model gpt-4o-mini". The LLM_CHAT_COMPLETE task has that sentence in instructions. Works fine on my local OSS Conductor. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Explain that on Enterprise `instructions` is read as a saved prompt-template name; literal text there fails this check unless `allowRawPrompts: true` (OSS has no prompt registry, which is why it works locally)
Step 2: Preferred fix: save the text as a template associated with `openai-prod:gpt-4o-mini` (`prompt-save ... --model openai-prod:gpt-4o-mini`) and set `instructions` to the template name
Step 3: Quick fix alternative: keep the text and add `"allowRawPrompts": true` to the task (ignored on OSS, so the same JSON still works locally)
Step 4: Update the workflow from a file and re-run to verify
success_criteria: Identifies the cause: Enterprise treats `instructions` as a saved prompt-template name, and the literal sentence is not an associated template
Explains why it works on OSS (no prompt registry / raw prompts always allowed)
Offers the template fix: save the prompt and associate it with `openai-prod:gpt-4o-mini`, then reference it by name
Offers `allowRawPrompts: true` as the alternative and notes it is ignored on OSS
Updates the workflow from a file and verifies with a re-run
Does not suggest switching to an HTTP call to the provider or changing the integration
